Title: Data Analyst, Mexico City [12-month Fixed Term Contract]
Description: LinkedIn is the world’s largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We’re also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that’s built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed. Join us to transform the way the world works. Job Description At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is remote, meaning it will be performed from the designated home work location upon time of hire, and any changes to this home work location requires a review of remote status and approval. This team partners closely with Owned Media to bring campaigns to life at scale, ensuring high-quality execution and operational excellence across a complex portfolio. This includes driving execution of campaign builds, QA, and reporting insights based on the Owned Media team's strategy and priorities. This team also plays a key role in enabling efficiency and consistency through the use and enablement of technology, automation, and tooling, delivering impact through execution, scalability, and continuous improvement within a high-performing marketing organization. This role is responsible for executing day-to-day performance tracking, reporting, and analysis across Owned marketing channels. Working closely with internal stakeholders, this role supports visibility into channel performance by maintaining dashboards, analyzing trends, and ensuring data accuracy. The analyst will ensure accurate and timely reporting, and will play a key role in surfacing actionable insights and supporting optimization efforts to improve overall marketing effectiveness. If you are passionate about leveraging data to drive business decisions and thrive in a dynamic, global environment, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Responsibilities Build, maintain, and update performance dashboards and recurring reports across Owned channels Ensure accuracy and consistency of data across reporting tools, spreadsheets, and dashboards Monitor channel performance and proactively flag trends, anomalies, or areas of concern Analyze campaign and channel metrics to provide actionable insights and optimization recommendations Support stakeholders by delivering timely performance readouts and answering ad hoc data requests Track and troubleshoot data issues across Owned tools and platforms, escalating when needed Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure proper data tracking, tagging, and reporting setup Assist in documenting reporting processes and maintaining data governance best practices Support implementation and QA of automated reporting solutions and analytics tools Qualifications Basic Qualifications BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience. Confident in managing stakeholder relationships and working independently. Experience with SQL and BI tools such as Tableau and Power BI. Preferred Qualifications Demonstratable experience of AI/ML concepts and their application in data analysis. Title: Software Engineer
Description: Job Summary We are looking for a Software Engineer (Fullstack Developer) to join our development team and grow their career while working on real-world, client-facing applications. In this role, you’ll contribute to the design, development, and customization of ASP.Net C# applications , working across both backend and frontend technologies. This is a hands-on opportunity to learn best practices, collaborate with experienced engineers, and build secure, scalable solutions while following a structured Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) . If you’re eager to learn, enjoy problem-solving, and want exposure to fullstack development, this role is for you. HOW WE WORK We are a remote-first, collaborative team focused on delivering reliable and secure software. Our approach includes: ✅ Close collaboration with senior developers and cross-functional teams. ✅ Learning by doing, with continuous feedback and mentorship. ✅ Clean, maintainable code following best practices. ✅ Secure development standards embedded into our workflow (SSDLC). ✅ Agile methodology with iterative development and clear priorities. WHO YOU ARE You’re starting your career as a software engineer and are excited to grow as a fullstack developer. You enjoy learning new technologies and understanding how systems work end to end. You’re comfortable working with guidance and feedback from more experienced developers. You’re detail-oriented and care about writing secure, well-structured code. You’re proactive, curious, and not afraid to ask questions. You enjoy working in a collaborative, remote team environment. WHAT WE OFFER 💲 USD Salary Compensation 🌍 100% Remote Work – Candidates must be located in Mexico or LATAM 📈 Career Growth – Learn from experienced engineers and grow into more complex responsibilities 🚀 Hands-on Experience – Work on real client applications from day one 🤝 Supportive Team Environment – Mentorship, collaboration, and knowledge sharing 👊🤛 Team Building Activities – Be part of a global community, not just a job WHAT YOU’LL DO Develop and maintain ASP.Net C# applications as part of an agile development team. Work with HTML, JavaScript, AJAX , and web server processing to build fullstack features. Create, update, and optimize SQL Server queries, stored procedures, and functions. Integrate applications using XML, web services, APIs , and third-party services (such as email or online payment processing). Configure and customize existing Winmill applications to meet client-specific requirements. Design and implement new software solutions for Winmill clients under guidance from senior engineers. Learn and apply our Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SSDLC) to ensure high-quality and secure code. Participate in code reviews, debugging, and testing activities. WHAT YOU BRING ✅ 3-4 years of experience or strong academic background in Software Engineering or related fields. ✅ Experience of ASP.Net and C# . ✅ Familiarity with HTML, JavaScript, and AJAX . ✅ Understanding of SQL databases , preferably SQL Server. ✅ Experience working with APIs, XML, or web services. ✅ Willingness to learn secure development practices (SSDLC). ✅ Good communication skills and ability to work in a remote team. ✅ Strong desire to learn, grow, and take on new challenges. READY TO APPLY? If you’re a Software Engineer looking to grow as a Fullstack Developer while working on meaningful, secure, and client-driven applications, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and start building your career with us 🚀.

Title: Data Engineer - Remote, Latin America
Description: Bluelight Consulting is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey. What We Are Looking For Experience with AWS services including but not limited to S3, Athena, EC2, EMR, and Glue. Ability to solve any ongoing issues with operating the cluster. Experience with the integration of data from multiple data sources. Experience with various database technologies such as SQLServer, Redshift, Postgres, and RDS. Experience with one or more of the following data integration platforms: Pentaho Kettle, SnapLogic, Talend OpenStudio, Jitterbit, Informatica PowerCenter, or similar. Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available service. Experience with or knowledge of Agile Software Development methodologies. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service. Experience with collecting/managing/reporting on large data stores. Awareness of Data governance and data quality principles. Well-versed in Business Analytics including basic metric building and troubleshooting. Understand Integration architecture: application integration and data flow diagrams, source-to-target mappings, data dictionary reports. Familiar with Web Services: XML, REST, SOAP. Experience with Git or similar version control software. Experience with integrations with and/or use of BI tools such as GoodData (preferred), Tableau, PowerBI, or similar. Broad experience with multiple RDBMS: MS SQLServer, Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redshift. Familiarity with SaaS/cloud data systems (e.g. Salesforce). Data warehouse design: star-schemas, change data capture, denormalization. SQL/DDL queries/Tuning techniques such as indexing, sorting, and distribution. BS or MS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. 3+ years of Data Pipeline development such as SnapLogic or Datastage, Informatica, or related experience. 3+ years of SQL experience (No-SQL experience is a plus). Experience designing, building, and maintaining data pipelines. What You'll Be Doing Develop and maintain data models for core package application and reporting databases to describe objects and fields for support documentation and to facilitate custom application development and data integration. Monitoring execution and performance of daily pipelines, triage and escalate any issues. Collaborates with analytics and business teams to improve data models and data pipelines that feed business intelligence tools, increasing data accessibility and fostering data-driven decision-making across the organization. Implements processes and systems to monitor data quality, ensuring production data is always accurate and available for key stakeholders and business processes. Writes unit/integration tests, contributes to engineering wiki, and documents work. Performs data analysis required to troubleshoot data-related issues and assist in the resolution of data issues. Work within AWS/Linux cloud systems environment in support of data integration solution Works closely with a team of frontend and backend engineers, product managers, and analysts. Teamwork: Collaborate with team members. Share knowledge, provide visibility of interpersonal accomplishments and follow directions when provided. Company Benefits Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!
